notes: 6.8.2: thinking/reasoning is now really OFF by default on every backend. Local thinking models (Ollama, LM Studio) used to burn the whole reply budget reasoning, so a text PDF came back largely untranslated; the /no_think prompt switch is not honored by qwen3/qwen3.5. Ollama now gets think=false, LM Studio reasoning_effort=none, and online providers each get the switch they accept (DeepSeek/GLM, DashScope/SiliconFlow, Gemini/OpenAI, OpenRouter). Measured: 1198-2048 tokens and 10-18 s per paragraph -> 16-23 tokens and 0.3 s. Set disable_thinking=false in system_config.json to opt out. / 6.8.2：思考模式现在在所有后端真正默认关闭。本地思考型模型（Ollama、LM Studio）此前会把回复预算全烧在推理上，导致 PDF 大片保留原文；/no_think 文本开关 qwen3/qwen3.5 并不认。现 Ollama 用 think=false、LM Studio 用 reasoning_effort=none、在线各家用各自生效的参数。实测每段 1198-2048 token、10-18 秒 -> 16-23 token、0.3 秒。如需思考，在 system_config.json 里把 disable_thinking 设为 false。
